_readme: SAMPLE DATA ONLY. Maroone USA is a prospect, not a client (proposal 2026-10-01). Every count, model, and timestamp here is illustrative, built to show Gabe Montano what the daily receipt looks like with one tab per rooftop. Never present as Maroone's real inventory. Shape mirrors shortline_change_log.json; the real file replaces this one when the first rooftop goes live. STYLE RULE (Wade, 2026-09-06): customer-facing, outcomes only - cars in, cars out, prices, timestamps. No internal machinery.
